title.narrative: Platform established for Communities of Practice on ASEAN Higher Education

description.narrative: Platform established for Communities of Practice on ASEAN Higher Education

comment.narrative: An ASEAN CoP in HE was not established before the SHARE Extension program

The SHARE Higher Education HE Harmonisation Community of Practice CoP officially launched in the SHARE Policy Dialogue 13 with total of existing 273 members engaged in the CoP platform. The SHARE Higher Education Harmonisation Community of Practice has now started to selfoperate transferred to the new RIHED SHARE Knowledge Hub platform and be integrated in the SEAMEO RIHEDs programme following the completion of SHARE Programme in December 2022.

title.narrative: ASEAN Working Group on Higher Education Mobility (AWGHEM) established to contribute to the realisation of the ASEAN Work Plan on Education 20212025 and formulation of the roadmap on higher education harmonisation

description.narrative: ASEAN Working Group on Higher Education Mobility (AWGHEM) established to contribute to the realisation of the ASEAN Work Plan on Education 20212025 and formulation of the roadmap on higher education harmonisation

comment.narrative: The ASEAN Working Group on Higher Education Mobility AWGHEM established to play a key role towards regional harmonisation and internationalisation. AWGHEM will function until 2025.

The ASEAN Working Group on Higher Education Mobility AWGHEM 2025 was officially launched at Policy Dialogue 12 on July 27th 2021. The AWGHEM is expected to contribute to the realisation of Outcome 3 of the ASEAN Work Plan on Education 20212025 with the ASEAN Secretariat and the ASEAN Foundation as CoChairs of the working group and SHARE as the technical and operational advisor with a total of 10 permanent members representing the 10 ASEAN Member States.In total four meeting of the AWGHEM on the implementation of ASEAN Education Work Plan 2021 2025 were conducted.
